findings.issue: PharmacySwitcher stores selection in localStorage but no component uses selectedPharmacyId to filter API calls or UI. The switcher appears functional but has no effect, misleading users into thinking they're viewing filtered data.
findings.suggestion: Either wire selectedPharmacyId to backend endpoints that support pharmacy_id filtering, add a UI note that filtering is 'coming soon,' or remove the switcher until backend support is ready.

findings.issue: Filter dropdown explicitly sets padding: '8px 12px' while search input relies on default padding, creating minor style inconsistency despite both meeting 44px touch target requirement.
findings.suggestion: Remove padding: '8px 12px' from filter dropdown inline styles and let both inputs use consistent CSS.

findings.issue: PharmacyProvider uses defensive fallback (user?.is_system_owner) that silently degrades to isSystemOwner=false when user is undefined, potentially masking integration errors where user arrives late or is accidentally null.
findings.suggestion: Consider making the error explicit (throw or return early when user is missing) or expose a dedicated initError field to signal that the context failed to initialize due to missing user prop.
